description: This file defines an interface for a transactional bit array grain in Orleans, including methods for pinging, setting bits, and retrieving states, with transaction options.

classes.name: ITransactionalBitArrayGrain
classes.description: An interface for a transactional bit array grain in Orleans, supporting ping, set, and get operations with transaction options.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Method to check the availability or responsiveness of the grain.

methods.name: SetBit
methods.description: Sets a bit to a new value within a transaction context.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current states of the bit array within a transaction context.
